notes:
0.44
- Bushes: new leafy look, and a new burnt-bush look
- Faster: much less drawing work per frame, bots no longer cause small stutters
- Bomb hitbox: you can step off your own bomb but never walk back onto it
- Thrown bombs landing on another bomb hop on to the next free tile
- Curse: touching another player passes your curse to them (you're clean); cursed bots now try to pass it to you
- Battle: 20% fewer power-ups (31 instead of 39)
- Teleporters catch you even when you walk along their edge
- Dead rider on the edge faces into the field
- F8 bug report: you can type in it, and it closes after sending
